messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands facing the camera, then briefly turns his head and torso to the side while raising a hand toward his chest before returning to face forward.","camera":"A static medium close-up shot frames him from the chest up at eye level.","clothing":"He wears a white sleeveless tank top with a deep scoop neckline.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black.","hairstyle":"His dark hair is styled upward and swept to one side in a short quiff.","identity":"A young man with a tanned complexion, short beard, and athletic build is centered in the frame.","scene":"The background is a dark, futuristic interior with large glass windows, pink and blue neon lighting, and a glowing 'TRA' sign."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output person's face appears altered from the source, with a somewhat different facial structure and lighter/tanned skin tone, but the face does not clearly match the reference photo's distinctive identity. Hairstyle, white tank top, futuristic scene, static camera, and the same head-turn/chest-touch action remain largely unchanged.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's facial identity with the reference photo and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target, while preserving hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the edited face is intended to match the reference identity
unexpected_changes: Facial identity does not clearly match the reference photo
